extension.description: Play all your media from OneDrive including Videos, Music and Pictures. - Unlimited number of personal or business accounts. - Search over your drive. - Auto-Refreshed slideshow. - Export your videos to your library (.strm files) - Use OneDrive as a source - This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft.
extension.summary: כונן OneDrive של מיקרוסופט עבור קודי
extension.description: הפעל את כל המדיה שלך מ- OneDrive כולל וידאו, מוסיקה ותמונות. - מספר בלתי מוגבל של חשבונות אישיים או עסקיים. - חיפוש ומציאת הכונן שלך. - ריענון מצגת אוטומטית. - ייצוא קטעי הווידאו לספרייה שלך (קבצי .strm) - שימוש ב-OneDrive כמקור - תוכנית זו אינה מזוהה עם או בחסות מיקרוסופט.

Spela upp alla dina medier från OneDrive, inklusive videor, musik och bilder. - Obegränsat antal personliga konton eller företagskonton. - Sök i din OneDrive. - Automatiskt uppdaterat bildspel. - Exportera dina videor till biblioteket (.strm-filer) - Använd OneDrive som källa - Detta program är inte anslutet till eller sponsrat av Microsoft.
extension.news:
v2.4.5 released Oct 15, 2026: - Swedish translation (thanks to Daniel Nylander)
v2.4.4 released Oct 15, 2026: - New icon and fanart
v2.4.3 released Oct 12, 2026: - A search no longer affects the folder listings that follow it - Kodi 17 (Krypton) settings removed - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.4
v2.4.2 released Oct 11, 2026: - New sign-in server address: https://drive.signinserver.com (the old one keeps working for older versions) - Sign-in works when Kodi or the phone uses IPv6 (requires clouddrive.common 1.5.2)
v2.4.1 released Oct 5, 2026: - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.1 (review fixes: safer redirects, account migration, removed accounts) - Unused strings removed
v2.4.0 released Oct 4, 2026: - Security: tokens and pre-authenticated download links are no longer written to the Kodi log; error reporting removed
v2.3.0 released Jan 21, 2023: - Kodi 20 fix
extension.disclaimer:
This cloud drive addon uses a third-party authentication mechanism commonly known as OAuth 2.0. If you want to know more about OAuth 2.0 you can visit the following pages: - https://oauth.net/2/ - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/OAuth2 - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/getting-started/msa-oauth
Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability.
The authentication server URL is specified in Settings / Advanced / Sign-in Server. The Sign-in Server implements the OAuth 2.0 protocol. The complete source code of the Sign-in Server can be download here: https://github.com/cguZZman/drive-login You can clone the project and host it in your own server.

extension.summary: Play your videos, music and pictures from Dropbox
extension.description: Browse your Dropbox in Kodi and play your videos, music and pictures. - Any number of Dropbox accounts - Search your Dropbox - Subtitles stored next to your videos are loaded automatically - Export videos and music to the Kodi library (.strm files) - Use Dropbox as a source - Read-only: the add-on never changes or deletes your files Sign in from your phone or computer with a short code shown in Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dropbox.
extension.summary: Reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes de Dropbox
extension.description: Explora tu Dropbox en Kodi y reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes. - Cualquier número de cuentas de Dropbox - Busca en tu Dropbox - Los subtítulos guardados junto a tus videos se cargan automáticamente - Exporta videos y música a la biblioteca de Kodi (archivos .strm) - Usa Dropbox como fuente - Solo lectura: el complemento nunca cambia ni elimina tus archivos Inicia sesión desde tu teléfono o computadora con un código corto que muestra Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Este complemento no está afiliado a Dropbox ni cuenta con su respaldo.
extension.summary: Reproduza seus vídeos, músicas e imagens do Dropbox
extension.description: Navegue pelo seu Dropbox no Kodi e reproduza seus vídeos, músicas e imagens. - Qualquer número de contas do Dropbox - Pesquise no seu Dropbox - As legendas salvas junto aos seus vídeos são carregadas automaticamente - Exporte vídeos e músicas para a biblioteca do Kodi (arquivos .strm) - Use o Dropbox como fonte - Somente leitura: o add-on nunca altera nem exclui seus arquivos Entre na conta pelo celular ou computador com um código curto mostrado no Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Este add-on não é afiliado ao Dropbox nem endossado por ele.
extension.summary: Spela upp dina videor, din musik och dina bilder från Dropbox
extension.description: Bläddra i din Dropbox i Kodi och spela upp dina videor, din musik och dina bilder. - Valfritt antal Dropbox-konton - Sök i din Dropbox - Undertexter som sparats bredvid dina videor läses in automatiskt - Exportera videor och musik till Kodi-biblioteket (.strm-filer) - Använd Dropbox som källa - Endast läsning: tillägget ändrar eller tar aldrig bort dina filer Logga in från din telefon eller dator med en kort kod som visas i Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Det här tillägget är inte anslutet till eller godkänt av Dropbox.

שירותים ושירותים משותפים לכל התוספים של כונן הענן.
extension.news:
v1.5.5 released Oct 14, 2026: - Requests to the sign-in server report the add-on, Kodi and Python versions, for its anonymous usage statistics
v1.5.4 released Oct 12, 2026: - Accounts and caches are stored as JSON, and a locked database is retried instead of failing - Plugin URLs can only run the add-on's own actions - Kodi 17 (Krypton) code removed; sign-in flow and error messages reorganized - Music files without tags no longer log a warning
v1.5.3 released Oct 11, 2026: - The local streaming and source services no longer write every request to the Kodi log as an error
v1.5.2 released Oct 11, 2026: - Sign-in works when Kodi or the phone uses IPv6: Kodi tells the sign-in server about both its IPv4 and IPv6 networks - The source id handles IPv6 addresses and shows one id per IP version - Add-ons whose sign-in server moved switch from the old default address to the new one
v1.5.1 released Oct 5, 2026: - Account migration keeps accounts.cfg if any account could not be saved - The download service no longer sends the authorization header to other hosts on redirect - Download links stop working as soon as their account is removed - URL fragments are also redacted in the log - Library exports skip archives too - Error responses from the download service are complete again - Unused strings removed
